title: Finite scalar extension preserves bounded constructibility at finite Tor amplitude
statement: Let $T$ be an arbitrary scheme, $A,B$ finite commutative rings in the module universe, $f:A\to B$ a ring map, $E$ any DerivedExtension of [def-pur-finite-reduction-system] on the small etale site, and $K$ a bounded constructible etale $A$-complex of Tor amplitude in an ordered interval $[a,b]$. Then $E(K)$ is bounded constructible as an etale $B$-complex. No Noetherian condition on $T$ or flatness of $f$ is imposed.

proof.text: Use the generic DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn_iff_exists_iso_Q_obj_flat to choose a bounded flat K-flat model. Compare restriction of its extension with tensor by the constant target-ring sheaf using [lem-pur-finite-reduction-restrict-tensor] and Etale.derivedTensorQObjSingleFunctorObjIso.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: The constant target-ring sheaf is finite locally constant over A. Apply the proved Etale.boundedConstructible_tensor with the finite-Tor factor K, using the proved tensor symmetry to put it in the required position. No new stratification lemma is needed.

proof.text: Exact restriction commutes with homology. The proved finite-coefficient restriction criterion reflects constructibility, after translating between the two constructibility predicates by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] and transporting along the homology isomorphism by [lemma-constructible-iso-invariance]; faithfulness of restriction reflects zero homology and therefore boundedness.

lean.statement: theorem boundedConstructible_extend (T : Scheme.{u}) {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (f : A →+* B) (E : DerivedExtension T.smallEtaleTopology f) (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (hK : Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible A T K) (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b) (hTor : Etale.DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn A T a b K) : Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible B T (E.functor.obj K)
